sites.name: Imperial City of Huế (Complex of Huế Monuments)
sites.what: Citadel and Purple Forbidden City of Vietnam's last dynasty (UNESCO World Heritage). Not ancient in age, but recorded as the province's main heritage site.

access.tickets: Imperial City VND 200,000 a person (about AUD 11, RBA rate 30 October 2026), same price for foreign and Vietnamese visitors; ages 7 to 12 VND 40,000; under 7 free.

laws.rule: Imperial City ₫200,000 (about A$11.02 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) adult (₫40,000 child 7 to 12). Minh Mang, Tu Duc and Khai Dinh tombs ₫150,000 each (₫30,000); Gia Long ₫150,000; Dong Khanh ₫100,000. Combos: three sites ₫420,000 (₫80,000); four sites ₫530,000 (₫100,000), valid two days; all sites ₫600,000 (₫120,000), valid five days.
